An orc shaman guards his treasure in a small orc outpost in the swamps east of Venore. Open the hidden hole with the shovel, go down into the {wiki:Venore Orc Cave|Venore Orc Cave}, kill the {creature:Orc Shaman} and his companions and open the box to receive a {item:Magic Light Wand}, an {item:Axe Ring} and a {item:Blank Rune}.
Small cave in the swamps east of Venore
Use the {item:Shovel} to open the hole and go down through it.
